Optional on-device model packs

These models are downloaded only after the user agrees, verified by SHA-256 and
run locally. Photos are never uploaded.

Objects and scenes: MobileNetV2 (mobilenetv2-12.onnx) from the ONNX Model Zoo,
https://github.com/onnx/models, licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
ImageNet class names (bundled as assets/models/imagenet_labels.txt) come from
the ONNX Model Zoo synset list, derived from WordNet (Princeton University
WordNet license).

Text in photos: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv3 English detection and recognition models
(https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR), Apache License 2.0, as ONNX files
published by the RapidOCR project (https://huggingface.co/SWHL/RapidOCR),
Apache License 2.0.

Apache License 2.0: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
